pattern.description: A Comment popover opens under the Tweaks panel, the request 'Add a dark mode tog...' types on character by character while the frame drifts up to keep it centred, and the cursor heads to the orange Send button.
pattern.why_premium: Typing, the drift and the cursor travel happen together, so the comment-to-edit flow is shown in under a second; the slow upward drift keeps the input in the optical centre while it grows.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.stage', {y: -170, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out'}); tl.to('.comment-input', {text: 'Add a dark mode toggle', duration: 0.8, ease: 'none'}, 0); tl.to('.cursor', {x: sendX, y: sendY, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, 0.1); tl.set('.cursor', {className: 'cursor hand'}, '>-0.05').
build_hint.remotion: stage translateY = -170 * spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 100}}); typed = text.slice(0, Math.floor(frame * charsPerFrame)); cursor x/y = interpolate(frame, [3, 13], [start, send], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}).

notes: Code reports camera.move tilt_down (small, pan_y -0.23), so the column movement may be a camera drift rather than per-element slides; listed per region because both columns shift. The Send button has no candidate box and does not visibly change, so it is not listed.
